title: Outcome Pipeline: Weekly Velocity Log
content:
Purpose: a compact weekly scratch to surface where my personal outcome pipeline is flowing or stuck. Not a polished report — a working ledger I can iterate on mid-week.

This week snapshot (week of 2026-03-08 -> 2026-03-14):
- Throughline / Objective (personal): Improve throughput on my key product experiments while preserving focus on quality checks. Phrase it as: "Ship higher-confidence micro-experiments that move metric signals, not vanity noise."

Personal OKR (quarter):
- Objective: Increase signal-to-noise on micro-experiments so my 1:10 experiment-to-outcome conversion improves.
- KR1: Move measurable metric (engagement on experiment cohort) from 3.6% -> 6.5% by end of Q.
- KR2: Run 8 tracked micro-experiments (with pre-defined hypothesis + measurement window) this quarter; 3 shipped with clear next-step decisions.
- KR3: Reduce personal cycle time from idea->deploy from avg 9 days -> 4 days for low-risk experiments.

This week: concrete items + quick status
1) A/B prompt routing test (low-risk): started Monday, tracking: retention@day3 for cohort. Data pipeline: manual sample for now. Status: collecting (n=420 users), preliminary delta +0.5ppt. Confidence: low. Next: automate extraction (ticket).
2) Mini-cache policy experiment (medium): blocked on infra quota for dedicated pool. Owner: SRE request pending. Status: blocked. Action: escalate to Rhea; draft rollback plan.
3) Ship readability checks for eval harness (low): PR open, reviewers = Noah, expected merge mid-week. If merged, triggers automated regression alert. Status: in_review.

Time budget this week (actual -> planned):
- Deep work on experiments: 8h -> 12h (slipped because of last-minute support)
- Meetings / syncs: 6h -> 4h (negotiated down)
- Ad hoc debugging / ops: 4h -> 6h (higher)
- Buffer / learning: 2h -> 4h

Quick retrospective notes (last week):
- What went well: trimmed scope for two experiments so they were easier to measure; got early signal on one.
- Pain points: handoffs to infra take too long; I lose momentum waiting on quotas.
- Hypothesis: setting up a light-weight pre-approved infra sandbox for low-risk experiments would cut cycle time by ~40%.

Micro-experiments ledger (short rows):
- prompt-routing-A: hypothesis = narrower prompts reduce hallucination and increase retention; metric = retention@day3; status = collecting; n=420; next = automation ticket PD-2026.
- cache-policy-b: hypothesis = prefix-caching for repeat queries reduces latency and increases throughput; metric = median p50 latency; status = blocked on GPU quota; next = escalate.
- readability-checks: hypothesis = explicit readability labels reduce QA time; metric = QA false-positive rate; status = in_review; next = merge + monitor.

Open questions to resolve by Friday:
- Can I get a recurring 2-hour deep-work block protected? (If not, tradeoff: compress experiments further.)
- Who will own the infra sandbox proposal (me or platform eng)? Recommend I draft short spec and hand to platform engineer for sign-off.
- Which two experiments this quarter are "priority-for-decision" (i.e., must yield a yes/no)? I nominate: prompt-routing-A and cache-policy-b.

Tickets to create / follow-ups:
- PD-2026: automate retention extraction for prompt-routing-A (linked above).
- PD-2027: infra sandbox proposal (spec + cost estimate) -> assign to Rhea for review.
- PD-2028: request GPU quota bump for dedicated-dev pool (include rollback plan).

Signals I will watch next week (daily quick checks):
- retention@day3 (cohorts by bucket), p50 latency for cached flow, number of experiments with pre-registered hypotheses, PR reviews closed.

Decision rules (quick):
- If retention delta < 1ppt and n>1000 after full window -> deprioritize variant.
- If infra blocking > 3 business days -> escalate to platform manager and mark experiment as paused.

Notes to self / quick voice memo bullets:
- Keep experiments small and measurable.
- Prefer automatic measurement even if sample smaller initially.
- Document rollback for any infra changes.

Short wins for the week (doable in 1-2 hours):
- Draft infra sandbox spec skeleton (30-60m).
- Create PD-2026 ticket with sample SQL snippet (20m).
- Ping Rhea + set 15m sync around quota status (10m).

Appendix: links I keep handy (copy into artifacts as needed):
- Redwood Console: route /metrics/my-experiments (bookmark)
- Local eval harness repo: github.com/redwood/eval-harness (branch: readability-checks)

End of log. Planned next edit: mid-week quick update (Wed) and short retrospective at week close (Sunday).
summary: Working weekly log focused on reducing experiment cycle time and improving signal quality. Tracks three active micro-experiments, time budget, blockers, tickets to raise, and decision rules.
